summary: Make the local autostart regression portable by using temporary storage paths and separating Core dispatch from the vmhost storage-ready start check. API impact: none.

guide.reason: Test fixture changes do not alter operator-visible behavior or workflows.

api.reason: The changes exercise existing autostart and VM power behavior without changing any API contract.

roadmap.reason: This fixes regression-test portability only; no recovery plan behavior or acceptance gate changes.

state.reason: Only test fixtures changed; no product state is introduced or moved.

verification.method: The agent test now uses a t.TempDir repository and asserts Core claims and dispatches the local autostart once per boot while its untrusted test path is correctly refused by the storage guard. A vmhost test uses the existing private managedStorageReadyFn test seam to prove a disk-backed local VM start reaches virsh after storage readiness succeeds. No host-global storage path was created.
